lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle, with the highest concentration and size located along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to create a grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank; the most prominent ridge shows a sharp luminance transition with light-colored pixels on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated along the anterior margin and the central surface area of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of small, high-luminance points that are significantly smaller and more closely packed than the blobs found on the primary lateral flank.
